_doc: Curated scene-composition overlay for the CPU-2 FA census (manual tier).
_method: Compiled 2026-08-23 from scene configs + Docs/reports/dropoff_cue_matrix_v1.md + experiments/v3_0823/CUE_COVERAGE.md + experiments/weekend_0823/cue_audit/H_CUE_AUDIT.md. Every field carries its file:line in `prov`.
_scoping_rule: 장식형 (decorative) is turned into an EVENT FLAG only where a specific installed object can be localised to a (sector, band) region of the polar grid. Scene-wide dressing is recorded as metadata (`decorative_present`) but is NOT converted into flags: a scene-wide flag would mark ~everything and destroy the family's discriminative content. 지형통계형 is likewise left to the mechanical rule (unseen cell / prior-saturated cell); the scene notes are used as corroboration in prose only. This keeps every number in the family table traceable to a mechanical rule or a measured heuristic, with manual overlay confined to 2 scenes.
_why_conservative: The direct causal test for 장식형 already exists and returned nothing: the CUE-OFF round scored CUE EVIDENCE 0 / 30 cells on the pre-registered primary rule (ACCOUNTING.md:95, :103-104). A census cannot manufacture the evidence that ablation did not find.
